headline: Neutral Ground Expands as Posts Change Hands
war_summary: Since the last edition, Weathered Expanse has undergone the broadest reshuffle: five of its nine strategic bases are now neutral, with three Warden-held and one Colonial-held, versus five Colonial, one Warden and three neutral previously. Its 56 event rows in the past day include five in the latest two hours, while casualty rates have accelerated. Nevish Line now stands at six Colonial and two Warden bases, with no neutral ground; 46 event rows include four in the latest two hours, the latest at 14:50 UTC. Callahan’s Passage remains wholly Warden-held, but activity has revived to 14 rows in 24 hours and two in the latest two hours. Linn’s Mercy remains seven Colonial, three Warden and one neutral, but has recorded no event in the latest two hours; ten fell within six. Marban Hollow remains divided four Warden, three Colonial and one neutral, also quiet in the latest two hours despite 11 events in six. Mooring County holds at eleven Warden to one Colonial, with 19 daily rows but none in the last two hours. The war remains unresolved; 34 victory towns are required.
